summary: Join our training course to learn how to evaluate long-term program success. Gain essential tools and insights to measure effectiveness and improve outcomes.
lede: Long-term program evaluation helps program managers, evaluation specialists and strategic planners assess whether initiatives create lasting value. It covers aligning objectives and KPIs with strategic priorities, choosing quantitative and qualitative data methods, analyzing trends and unintended outcomes, and using findings to refine programs and communicate results to stakeholders.
modules: Building a Culture of Evaluation Excellence
